-- by MOH
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

local FPS = 15
local DIR = "tb_intro_v5"
local S = {enabled = false, power = 48, range = 10}

local mainConn
local buildGUI

local mainStarted = false
local function startMain()
    if mainStarted then return end
    mainStarted = true

    local function hasGreenHighlight(targetChar)
        for _, desc in ipairs(targetChar:GetDescendants()) do
            if desc:IsA("Highlight") then
                local fc = desc.FillColor
                if fc.G > fc.R and fc.G > fc.B then
                    return true
                end
            end
        end
        return false
    end

    mainConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        if not S.enabled then return end
        local char = LocalPlayer.Character
        if not char then return end

        local equippedTool = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
        if not equippedTool then return end

        local rootPart = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local humanoid = char:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")

        if not rootPart or not humanoid then return end

        local nearestPlayer = nil
        local shortestDist = math.huge
        for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if p ~= LocalPlayer and p.Character then
                local targetRoot = p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                local targetHum = p.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")

                if targetRoot and targetHum and targetHum.Health > 0 then
                    if not hasGreenHighlight(p.Character) then
                        local dist = (rootPart.Position - targetRoot.Position).Magnitude
                        if dist <= S.range and dist < shortestDist then
                            shortestDist = dist
                            nearestPlayer = p
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        if nearestPlayer and nearestPlayer.Character then
            local targetRoot = nearestPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("Head") or nearestPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

            if targetRoot and humanoid.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0.1 then
                local targetPos = targetRoot.Position
                local lookAtPos = Vector3.new(targetPos.X, rootPart.Position.Y, targetPos.Z)
                local dirToTarget = (lookAtPos - rootPart.Position).Unit

                local weight = (S.power / 100) * 1.0
                local blendedDir = humanoid.MoveDirection:Lerp(dirToTarget, math.clamp(weight, 0, 1))

                if blendedDir.Magnitude < 0.01 then blendedDir = dirToTarget end
                humanoid:Move(blendedDir.Unit, false)
            end
        end
    end)

    print("MOH HUB Loaded")
    if buildGUI then task.spawn(buildGUI) end
end
